summary: A 2.13 m (7 ft) two-piece spinning rod: rubber butt cap, cork rear and fore grips either side of a graphite r… joints crank, bail; options reel, blank_colour, wrap_colour; sockets line_tip, line_spool, grip_r, grip_l, sight, muzzle.
